easy.def: A small bit of food between meals.
examples: I eat a snack after school.
The snack is an apple.
We packed a snack.

more.def: A small amount of food that you eat between meals.
examples: I eat an apple for a snack after school.
We packed snacks for the long car ride.
The kids shared a snack at recess.

easy.def: A long animal with no legs that slides on the ground.
examples: The snake slid away.
A snake has scales.
I saw a snake.

more.def: A long, thin animal with no legs and scaly skin.
examples: The snake slid through the grass.
A snake sheds its skin as it grows.
Some snakes live in trees.

easy.def: To break with a sharp sound.
examples: The twig will snap.
The branch snapped in half.
I heard the stick snap.

more.def: To break suddenly with a short, sharp sound.
examples: The dry stick snapped under his foot.
The rubber band snapped when I stretched it too far.
Ice on the pond snapped and cracked.
I heard a snap.
The snap of the twig made me jump.
The lid closed with a snap.

more.def: A sudden, short, sharp sound like something breaking or closing.
examples: The lid shut with a loud snap.
We heard the snap of a branch in the forest.
A snap of her fingers made the dog sit.
The bird snatched a crumb.
He snatched the ball.
She snatched her hat.

more.def: To grab something quickly and suddenly.
examples: The seagull snatched a chip from my hand.
He snatched the ball out of the air.
She snatched her hat before the wind took it.

easy.def: To move quietly so no one sees you.
examples: The cat sneaks up.
She sneaked into the room.
He snuck out.

more.def: To move quietly so that no one notices you.
examples: The cat sneaked up on the bird.
She sneaked into the room to surprise her mom.
He sneaked a cookie from the jar.

easy.def: To breathe in through your nose with a short sound.
examples: The dog sniffs the grass.
I sniffed the flower.
She sniffed the soup.

more.def: To breathe in air through your nose in short breaths, to smell something.
examples: The dog sniffed around the yard.
The dog sniffed every bush along the path.
He sniffed because his nose was runny.
The snow is cold.
We play in the snow.
Snow covered the yard.

more.def: Soft white flakes of frozen water that fall from the sky.
examples: Snow covered the ground overnight.
We built a snowman in the deep snow.
The children caught snow on their tongues.
It snows in winter.
It snowed all night.
I hope it snows.

more.def: To fall from the sky as flakes of ice.
examples: It snows a lot in the mountains.
It snowed for three days.
I hope it snows on my birthday.
